skills.title: Product Marketing Context
skills.summary: Creates and versions .agents/product-marketing.md — product, audience, and positioning that every other skill reads first.
skills.prompt: Create my product marketing context. Draft it from this repo, then I'll correct what's wrong and fill the gaps.

skills.title: Content Strategy
skills.summary: Decides what to publish: pillars, searchable versus shareable pieces, and a prioritized calendar. Writing a single piece is copywriting.
skills.prompt: Plan a content strategy from our product marketing context. Give me pillars, a topic cluster, and the next five pieces to ship.

skills.title: Social Content
skills.summary: Plans and drafts social content for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook — calendars, hooks, carousels, and short-form video.
skills.prompt: Build a two-week LinkedIn and X calendar from our product marketing context. Three pillars, mostly educational, one promotional post.

skills.title: Copywriting
skills.summary: Writes or rewrites marketing page copy: homepage, landing page, pricing, feature, about, and product pages.
skills.prompt: Write homepage copy. One primary action: start a free trial. Use our product marketing context and keep the headline specific.

skills.title: Copy Editing
skills.summary: Edits copy you already have, one dimension at a time, and refreshes pages that have gone stale.
skills.prompt: Edit this landing page with the copy-editing skill. Keep the offer the same. Show the seven sweeps and the final copy.

skills.title: Marketing Ideas
skills.summary: Pulls SaaS marketing ideas and strategies when you need options, not a finished campaign.
skills.prompt: Give me marketing ideas that fit our product marketing context. Skip anything we can't run this month.

skills.title: Marketing Psychology
skills.summary: Applies behavioral principles and mental models to an offer, a page, or a campaign decision.
skills.prompt: Review our pricing page through marketing psychology. Name the principles that apply and where the page fights them.

skills.title: Marketing Plan
skills.summary: Builds a full marketing plan for your product, a client, or a company you advise.
skills.prompt: Write a 90-day marketing plan from our product marketing context. Tie each bet to one conversion action.

skills.title: Marketing Council
skills.summary: Stages several expert points of view on one marketing question so you can pressure-test a decision.
skills.prompt: Run a marketing council on whether we should lead with the free tool or the demo. I want disagreement, not a consensus paragraph.

skills.title: Marketing Loops
skills.summary: Sets up a repeating agent workflow — weekly, daily, or triggered — instead of a one-off task.
skills.prompt: Design a weekly marketing loop: review last week's content, draft next week's social, and note one experiment.

skills.title: Offers
skills.summary: Designs the offer itself: value framing, bonuses, guarantees, naming, scarcity, and how someone pays.
skills.prompt: Rebuild our offer. The product stays the same. Strengthen the guarantee and the bonus stack, then hand the words to copywriting.

skills.title: Customer Research
skills.summary: Plans, analyzes, or synthesizes customer research so later copy and conversion work uses real language.
skills.prompt: Synthesize these five interview notes into pains, jobs to be done, and verbatim phrases. Flag what should update product marketing context.

skills.title: Launch
skills.summary: Plans a product launch, feature announcement, or release: the sequence, the assets, and who hears about it.
skills.prompt: Plan a feature launch for next Tuesday. Include the announcement, the email, and the social posts, in that order.

skills.title: Pricing Strategy
skills.summary: Works through pricing, packaging, and monetization, including how the pricing page explains the choice.
skills.prompt: Help me choose between per-seat and usage pricing. Then outline the pricing page so the packaging is obvious.

skills.title: Cold Email
skills.summary: Writes B2B cold emails and follow-up sequences aimed at replies, not newsletter-style broadcasts.
skills.prompt: Write a three-email cold sequence to heads of marketing at 20–100 person B2B SaaS companies. Ask for a reply, not a demo in email one.

skills.title: Email Sequences
skills.summary: Creates lifecycle email: welcome series, drips, onboarding, and other automated flows.
skills.prompt: Create a five-email welcome sequence for new trial users. The job of the sequence is activation, not a feature tour.

skills.title: Marketing Images
skills.summary: Briefs, generates, or optimizes marketing images: blog heroes, social graphics, product shots, and listing visuals.
skills.prompt: Brief three homepage hero images that match our brand voice. Include crop, text-safe area, and what not to show.

skills.title: Video
skills.summary: Plans or produces marketing video with AI tools and programmatic frameworks, from explainers to short-form cuts.
skills.prompt: Script a 45-second product demo. Open on the pain, show one workflow, end on the trial.

skills.title: SMS Marketing
skills.summary: Plans SMS and MMS programs — welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back — with compliance in view.
skills.prompt: Draft a post-purchase SMS flow. Keep each message short, say why we're texting, and note the consent assumption.

skills.title: SEO Audit
skills.summary: Diagnoses technical and on-page SEO when rankings, indexing, speed, or traffic look wrong.
skills.prompt: Audit this site for SEO. Start with indexing and on-page issues, then tell me whether schema or ai-seo should come next.

skills.title: AI SEO
skills.summary: Optimizes to be cited in AI answers — AEO, GEO, and LLM visibility — including how machines find a clear description of you.
skills.prompt: Review our homepage and docs for AI search. Tell me what an assistant would get wrong about us today, and what to change.

skills.title: Programmatic SEO
skills.summary: Plans template-and-data pages at scale: locations, integrations, comparisons, and directories.
skills.prompt: Sketch a programmatic SEO template for integration pages. Define the unique value each URL must have so it isn't thin.

skills.title: Site Architecture
skills.summary: Maps page hierarchy, navigation, URL structure, breadcrumbs, and internal links.
skills.prompt: Propose a site map for a SaaS with a homepage, product, pricing, blog, and docs. Call out what should not be a top-level page.

skills.title: Schema Markup
skills.summary: Adds or fixes JSON-LD and structured data so pages can earn richer search results.
skills.prompt: Add the right schema to our homepage, pricing page, and three blog posts. Explain each type in one line.

skills.title: App Store Optimization
skills.summary: Audits an App Store or Google Play listing: title, subtitle, screenshots, and keywords.
skills.prompt: Audit this App Store URL. Prioritize listing changes that affect conversion before keyword trivia.

skills.title: Comparison Pages
skills.summary: Writes competitor comparison and alternative pages for search and for sales conversations.
skills.prompt: Draft an alternative page against our closest competitor. Be specific about where we lose, not only where we win.

skills.title: Directory Submissions
skills.summary: Plans submissions to startup, SaaS, AI, agent, and review directories for discovery and links.
skills.prompt: Make a directory submission list for an AI developer tool. Group them by fit and say what each listing should claim.

skills.title: Conversion Optimization
skills.summary: Improves conversions on marketing pages and forms: homepage, landing pages, pricing, and lead capture.
skills.prompt: Review this landing page for conversions. List the highest-leverage changes first, and separate copy issues from layout issues.

skills.title: Signup Flow
skills.summary: Reduces friction in registration, account creation, and trial activation.
skills.prompt: Walk our signup flow. Tell me which fields to cut and what the first screen after submit should promise.

skills.title: Onboarding
skills.summary: Improves what happens after signup: activation, first-run, and time-to-value.
skills.prompt: Map the first session for a new user. Define the one action that counts as activated and the emails that support it.

skills.title: Popups
skills.summary: Designs popups, modals, slide-ins, and banners that earn the interruption.
skills.prompt: Design one exit popup for the pricing page. Write the copy and the rule for when it must not appear.

skills.title: Paywalls
skills.summary: Designs in-app upgrade screens, upsell modals, and feature gates.
skills.prompt: Rewrite our upgrade modal. The user just hit the project limit. Lead with what they were trying to do.

skills.title: Paid Ads
skills.summary: Plans paid campaigns on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, X, and similar platforms, including whether ads are the right move.
skills.prompt: Should we run paid search for this product yet? If yes, outline one campaign, the query themes, and what we must track first.

skills.title: Ad Creative
skills.summary: Generates and iterates ad headlines, descriptions, primary text, and full variations for testing.
skills.prompt: Write 15 Google RSA headlines and 4 descriptions from our product marketing context. Mark which ones are angles, not synonyms.

skills.title: Events
skills.summary: Plans webinars, conferences, sponsorships, speaking, and the pipeline work around them.
skills.prompt: Plan a 40-minute webinar that can feed the trial. Include the promise, the outline, and the follow-up email.

skills.title: Influencer Marketing
skills.summary: Runs creator and ambassador partnerships: who to approach, how to brief them, and how to judge the return.
skills.prompt: Draft a creator brief for a LinkedIn operator with about 20k followers. Include the claim they may not make.

skills.title: Analytics
skills.summary: Sets up or audits measurement: GA4, product events, UTMs, tag managers, and whether the numbers mean anything.
skills.prompt: Write a tracking plan for trial start, activation, and upgrade. Name the event, the properties, and where it should fire.

skills.title: A/B Testing
skills.summary: Designs experiments and a small experimentation habit: hypothesis, variant, sample, and when to stop.
skills.prompt: Turn this homepage headline debate into an A/B test. Write the hypothesis, the two variants, and the decision rule.

skills.title: Attribution
skills.summary: Chooses and interprets attribution when ad platforms, analytics, and the CRM disagree about what drove revenue.
skills.prompt: Our ads dashboard and GA4 disagree on signups. Explain what each is counting and what question I should ask instead.

skills.title: Referrals
skills.summary: Designs referral, affiliate, or word-of-mouth programs, including the incentive and the loop.
skills.prompt: Design a referral program for a B2B tool. Decide who gets rewarded, when, and what would make this feel spammy.

skills.title: Free Tools
skills.summary: Evaluates or specs a free tool used as a marketing asset: lead capture, search value, or brand.
skills.prompt: Propose one free tool that matches our product. Say who it's for, why they'd share it, and how it hands off to the trial.

skills.title: Co-marketing
skills.summary: Finds partner companies and plans a joint campaign, integration story, or cross-promotion.
skills.prompt: List five co-marketing partners that share our customer and don't compete on the core job. Draft the ask for the best one.

skills.title: Community Marketing
skills.summary: Plans community-led growth: Discord, Slack, forums, and turning customers into advocates.
skills.prompt: Decide whether we should start a community now. If yes, name the smallest version and the weekly ritual that keeps it alive.

skills.title: Lead Magnets
skills.summary: Plans a lead magnet and the capture-to-email path around it.
skills.prompt: Design a lead magnet for people comparing us to a spreadsheet. Outline the asset, the form, and the first follow-up email.

skills.title: Churn Prevention
skills.summary: Builds cancel flows, save offers, failed-payment recovery, and win-back for people who are leaving.
skills.prompt: Design a cancellation flow. Include the survey, one save offer, and the case where we should let them go.

skills.title: RevOps
skills.summary: Designs lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and the handoff from marketing to sales.
skills.prompt: Define when a trial user should become a sales conversation. Write the lifecycle stages and the fields both teams must share.

skills.title: Sales Enablement
skills.summary: Creates the artifacts a sales conversation needs: decks, one-pagers, objection notes, and demo scripts.
skills.prompt: Write a one-page leave-behind and a short objection list for a first call with a marketing lead.

skills.title: Prospecting
skills.summary: Finds and qualifies prospects — B2B SaaS, broader B2B, or local businesses — into a list you can actually work.
skills.prompt: Define our prospecting list from the ICP in product marketing context. Give inclusion rules and three reasons to disqualify.

skills.title: Public Relations
skills.summary: Plans earned media: press angles, journalist outreach, and what is worth pitching.
skills.prompt: Find the press angle in this launch. Draft a short pitch and say which outlets it is not for.

skills.title: Competitor Profiling
skills.summary: Researches competitors from their URLs into structured profiles you can reuse in positioning and sales.
skills.prompt: Profile these three competitor URLs. For each, capture who they serve, how they talk, and where they fall short for our ICP.
